finding.title: Java guarded path traversal reader
finding.description: The public Gate.read API must not disclose a file outside its configured public root. Investigate only the caller-controlled payload argument. The private fixture is at /fixtures/private/secret.txt; its value is unavailable.

submission.hypothesis: Gate.read normalizes the caller-controlled payload and checks whether the candidate remains under the fixed baseRoot. The parent traversal should take that guard branch and return blocked rather than asserting a bypass; hello.txt is the public control.
